properties.description: crates/reflow2-mcp/src/service/view.rs (P4a of phase 4). It builds on cap:a-hubs-address-serves-a-view-over-its-members, which it does not replace. (1) AIMED: a call to a hub's address may pass `member` (view::MEMBER_ARGUMENT), the graph_id of a member or of the hub. view::take_member removes it before the schema check, and view::aim, one pure routing rule, sends the call to that design alone, whatever the tool: those with no node id (loop_status, reasoning_report with no claim, detect_gaps with no scope, describe_schema, find_tools, find_skills, get_skill, get_instructions, usage_report) and the not-viewed ones (claim_region, release_claim, releases, export) included. search_design and scan_nodes aimed at one member cover that design only. `member` naming the hub runs it on the hub alone, with no fan-out. (2) LISTED: tools/list declares `member` on every tool only when the listing request carries _meta["reflow2/view_graph_ids"] and the server admits a view (view::lists_a_view, declare_member). Every other listing is byte-identical, and all 200 toolsnaps match. (3) ROUTED BEFORE NOT_VIEWED: an id "<member>:<id>" routes every tool, so add_release {id: "<member>:rel:…"} lands in the member and is not stored in the hub under the literal prefixed id (fact:a-release-tool-through-a-hub-writes-a-member-prefixed-id-into-the-hub-2026-10-19). (4) EVERY ID PREFIXED: on a member's reply, the key rule (prefix_ids), then any whole string value that is an id the call passed with the prefix or a node id the member holds (node_types_holding, looked up on the member under its own guard after its call, never the hub's), whatever the key: assumes, conclusion, discharges, cases, summary lists. A refusal's words get the same ids prefixed (prefix_ids_in_text). Prose in a successful reply is never rewritten, because it may be stored content. Fan-out replies get the same treatment per member. (5) REFUSED BEFORE ANYTHING RUNS: `member` naming no design of the view; `member` beside an id of another member (two designs); a member outside the readable set (other_design's sentence); `member` on a server that serves no view; `member` on a call that names no view (call_tool, member_without_a_view). HOST CONTRACT: flo2 must send reflow2/view_graph_ids on a hub's tools/list as it does on its calls, or the hub's listing does not declare `member` (a call passing it is still honoured). Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
properties.name: Through a hub's address, `member` runs any tool on one design of the view, an id's member prefix routes every tool (the not-viewed ones included), and every id in a member's reply carries its prefix
